div.div:
Why two routes
Argo CD sends no Cache-Control on API GETs. A page request that does not accept text/html (curl, a probe) gets the file as built, with <base href="/">, or a 404. Cloudflare cached all of these by URL and served them to every browser.

request that does not accept text/html (curl, a probe)

div.div: Fixed on 19 November 2026, Helm revisions 3 to 6: a cached /argocd/ with the wrong base (blank page), a cached signed-out userinfo (login loop) and a signed-in /api/v1/clusters served to anyone, a curl's cached 404 for /argocd/applications, and Rocket Loader holding back main.js (blank page).
